message: So, the other day I was cooking dinner and totally forgot I had a pot on the stove. 🤦‍♀️ I rushed in, smoke alarm blaring like it was auditioning for a musical, and there I was, frantically waving a dish towel to clear the air. Nothing like a little kitchen chaos to remind you how important it is to have a smoke alarm and an escape plan! Funny how life teaches you lessons in the most unexpected ways. Do you have your family’s fire escape route mapped out?
